damageLaw: In the Pillow Fields no blow is an instant KO (since v29.70): a blow that once KO'd (the pounce, the landing, the cuts, the hooves, the saddle swing, the Emperor's sword on foot and from the saddle) takes 36 (MEGA 49.5) HP off the man's sheet (0.9 x the machine gunner's HP at the fight's level 100 (MEGA 140)), landing whole, bar hits = the HP x his bar / his HP: a rifleman falls to one; any other man (Sarge and the heroes too) stands his first from a full bar, on 15 % of it (since v31.00), and the next fells him; one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men. Any Sarge and Jane under a moving horse take the same bite; a beast hero takes 1 bar hit x the damper a pass. A cotton lob takes 0.9 x a Rifleman's HP at the man's rank, landing whole (since v31.20); a lieutenant's cut on a flame 3.6 HP. A glob 2 x the share (90 % + 10 % x bar / HP) and a Bluecoat's cut on Sarge or a hero 1 x the share land at 50 % by the damper; a man left alone 4 s mends one bar hit. Difficulty scales the bodies (x1 · 1.35 · 1.5 · 1.8), the head-counts (x1 · 1.25 · 1.5 · 1.5) and the price (36 · 36 · 36 · 49.5 HP); the Emperor's two bars are the designers' time-to-kill chart's (MEGA the player-damage-threshold pass's table) and no longer carry the price of the player's campaign rung past 50, which still rides his Bluecoats, officer and cannons when he fights solo (x1 in a party, or at rung 50 or under) and lowers his cavalrymen's bars.
headlines: No blow is an instant KO since v29.70: every blow of the bears' bodies that once KO'd (the cub's pounce, the paratrooper's landing, a Bluecoat's and the officer's cut, the hooves, the saddle swing, the Emperor's sword on foot and now from the saddle) is a priced bite of 36 (MEGA 49.5) HP off the man's sheet, landing whole. A rifleman (26 · 26 · 29 · 33 HP at the lab's levels) still falls to one; since v31.00 every other man stands his first from a full bar, on 15 % of it, and one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men.

Sarge too: under a moving horse any Sarge and Jane take the bite (a gun Sarge stands his first from a full bar, on 15 % of it where the bite would empty it); the saber's blade turns about half the bites (on a pounce it rolls twice: 28–35 of 40 turned, both engines); the Emperor's cut never fells a fresh saber Sarge with its first landed blow, the next fells him (measured 80 of 80). At rest only a blade-in-hand Sarge keeps his feet under the saddle swing: a gun Sarge and every hero take the blow and a 182–185 px throw (measured, both engines); a hero one blow from the KO falls under the Emperor's hooves (the cavalry never take his last).

The cannon's lob (since v31.20) takes 0.9 x a Rifleman's HP at the man's rank, landing whole: 2–6 lobs 3.5 s apart KO every man, 4–14 a hero, and it hurts the bears in its splash. The glob lands at 50 % since the damper (2 bar hits x 0.5 x the share: 8–23 globs to a KO on a 7-bar man, measured over 40 runs); a Bluecoat's cut on Sarge or a hero 0.5 bar hit; on a flame a lieutenant's cut costs 3.6 HP (34 · 34 · 37 · 39 cuts fell a fresh flame at the lab's levels).

The Emperor fights on two bars: 1,240 · 1,653 · 2,478 · 6,339 each solo at the lab's levels 50 · 57 · 63 · 70 (the designers' time-to-kill chart; MEGA the player-damage-threshold pass's table; 1,240 · 1,654 · 2,481 · 6,345 at rung 50 or under); a party pays the tier alone: 2,358 · 3,147 · 4,712 · 12,042 with two commanders. Since v31.20, at or above 80 % of his mounted bar he walks his horse at the nearest man and cuts him from the saddle every 1.5 s; under it he rides and charges as before; at 0 the unhorse takes 3 s: he scampers back, says "Suivez-moi, à la gloire!", blows the whistle and the EN GARDE! wave rushes; 150 dog tags for phase one; on foot he parries 20 % of a saber or Claymore Sarge's swings.

His army never stops coming: the battery of 2 cotton cannons at the ride's start, a Bluecoat detail with the officer every 9–14 s while he rides (a battalion of 4 + a fresh cannon every third), and on foot a wave of 3 Bluecoats + 2 cannons every 8–15 s, every 6–10 s with no waiting once his second bar is under half; the slingshot bears come down when his mounted bar passes 50 % or 60 s in, a second stick 12 s after the unhorse.

MEGA changes the bodies (x1.8), the head-counts (x1.5) and the price of a former KO (49.5 HP at the fight's MEGA level 140), never a new hit: the Ice Castle's +20 % and double weather are not the fields' law. The stone wall and the reflect are switched off.

RAZIYA'S BOSS NOTES, every boss fight on EASY to MEGA: no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (he stands on 15 % of it; the next fells him); one blow reaches at most 3 · 4 · 4 · 5 men (E · M · H · G); the jeep's ram still fells what it clips but costs the jeep 0.5 · 0.5 · 0.6 · 0.75 of a bar hit and slows it (a lieutenant 0.25 · 0.25 · 0.3 · 0.35 since v31.20). ULTRA MEGA reads none of it.

THE KINGS' +120 HP FROM RANK 30: King Yeti, King Rex, King Croak and the Emperor Bear hero each stand 120 HP and 120 bar hits more from their own rank 30: at level 50 King Yeti 242 HP / 234 bar hits (was 122 HP / 114 bar hits), King Rex 296 HP / 225 bar hits (was 176 HP / 105 bar hits), King Croak 321 HP / 285 bar hits (was 201 HP / 165 bar hits), the Emperor Bear hero 304 HP / 225 bar hits (was 184 HP / 105 bar hits). Jane and Princess Croak as they were.

NO INSTANT KO (Isaac's pass): every blow that KO'd outright here (the pounce, the landing, the cuts, the hooves, the saddle swing, the Emperor's sword) takes 0.9 x the machine gunner's HP at rank 57 for the fight's level 100 (MEGA 140, rank 80) = 36 (MEGA 49.5) HP off the man's sheet, landing whole: a rifleman (26 HP at level 50) still falls to one, a flame takes 2.08 of 7 bar hits, every hero stands it. THE HEAVY CLASS: the bazooka, the flame and the commando stand on at least 2 machine gunners' HP: the bazooka 80 · 80 · 90 · 101 HP at the lab's levels (was 74 · 74 · 88 · 101); the flame and the commando already stood higher.

The bazooka's and the commando's tenth-rank HP bonus doubled (+5 more HP a tenth rank for the bazooka, +5 for the commando): at the lab's levels 50 · 57 · 63 · 70 the bazooka has 74 · 74 · 88 · 101 HP (was 49 · 49 · 58 · 66), the commando 83 · 83 · 96 · 110 (was 58 · 58 · 66 · 75). Shotgun Sarge +20 HP for every ten shotgun ranks while the shotgun is in his hands: 135 · 135 · 157 · 180 HP (was 35 · 35 · 37 · 40); his other irons as they were. A glob or a lob lands a hair lighter on them (the share); the KO strikes do not care.

The flame's tenth-rank HP rungs through level 50 tripled: +60 HP at every lab level, 121 · 121 · 130 · 140 (was 61 · 61 · 70 · 80); every other man as he was. A glob or a lob lands a hair lighter on him (the share); the KO strikes do not care.

The designers' time-to-kill chart sets the Emperor's bar for one commander on EASY, MEDIUM and HARD: 1,240 · 1,654 · 2,481 at rung 50 or under, 1,240 · 1,653 · 2,478 at the lab's levels 50 · 57 · 63 (was 152 · 233 · 287 at the lab's levels, 152 · 205 · 228 at rung 50 or under). The price of the player's rung no longer moves his bar (the player-damage-threshold pass cancelled it first at v29.30, its multiplier figured over the priced bar; the chart wrote its own numbers over that at v29.37), so the price cancels and the lab's level lands 0 to 3 HP under the chart's number. The cavalryman's bar rides the same multiplier: 514 · 605 · 820 (was 63 · 85 · 95). A party of two: 2,358 · 3,147 · 4,712 (was 289 · 390 · 433). MEGA keeps the player-damage-threshold pass's table (its row).

The player-damage-threshold pass writes the boss's bar for one commander into his row's multiplier at four decimals, figured over the solo bar with the rung's price in it: the price cancels on the Emperor's bar and stays on his Bluecoats, officer and cannons; the cavalryman's boss-typed row takes the same multiplier, so a solo player's price now LOWERS his bar (605 at the lab's level 57 against 687 at rung 50 or under on MEDIUM) while a party's rows carry no price. On MEGA the Emperor's bar is the pass's table: 6,345 at rung 50 or under, 6,339 at the lab's level 70 (was 390 at the lab's level, 274 at rung 50 or under); the cavalryman 1,845 (was 113); a party of two 12,042 (was 520). The designers' time-to-kill chart took EASY, MEDIUM and HARD from this table the same day (its row).

THE DAMPER: every enemy blow on your men lands at 50 % in the campaign and the boss fights. Here a glob lands 0.93 of a level-50 rifleman's 7 bar hits (it was 1.85), a lob a quarter of his bar (5 lobs to a KO, the law until v31.20), a Bluecoat's cut or the saddle swing on Sarge or a hero and the hooves on a hero 0.5 bar hit (x his share on Sarge): a man stands twice the blows he did. A KO is not dampened: the pounce, the landing, the swords and the hooves on a man land as shipped.
King Croak the hero is tougher on every rank: 201 HP and 165 bar hits at level 50. Every blow lands on him as on any hero.
+3 HP every tenth rank for the bazooka, grenadier, flame and commando; a glob or a lob lands a hair lighter on them (the share), the KO strikes do not care.
Your bomber flies in every boss fight, the Pillow Fields included.
One HP number: a glob, a lob and a Bluecoat's cut on Sarge land 90 % + 10 % x bar / HP of their bar hits.

The Boss Lab fights the Emperor with its stock army at level 50 · 57 · 63 · 70. Past rung 50 that level's price rode his bars until the player-damage-threshold pass (v29.30; the chart then wrote its own numbers over it at v29.37); today it rides his Bluecoats, officer and cannons (x1 · 1.136 · 1.257 · 1.422) and lowers the cavalryman's bar.
A party grows the Emperor's and the cavalry's bars (x1 + 0.9 a commander past the first) instead of multiplying them.

questions.text: The page goes to Raziya as is (through the dashboard and Wyatt's forward).

A balance read, not a bug: no strike is an instant KO since v29.70, but at the lab's levels a rifleman (26 · 26 · 29 · 33 HP) still falls to one priced bite (36 (MEGA 49.5) HP) of the nine strikes that carry it, and since v31.00 every other man stands his first from a full bar only to fall to the second (a medic, a pistol or saber Sarge); the flame, the bazooka, the commando and the heroes stand several.

The Emperor's bar no longer carries the price of the player's campaign rung: the designers' time-to-kill chart's multiplier is figured over the priced bar, so a solo player at the lab's level 57 meets 1,653 on MEDIUM and one at rung 50 or under 1,654 (the chart's own number). The price still rides his Bluecoats, officer and cannons (x1 · 1.136 · 1.257 · 1.422 at the lab's levels, x2.167 at rung 100, capped x4) and now LOWERS the cavalryman's bar (605 against 687 on MEDIUM). Is that the law Isaac wants: a priced army and weaker cavalry under an unpriced king, the higher the solo player's rung?
questions.rec: a word for Isaac; the dashboard shows the lab's solo bar (the HP shown), the rung-50 bar beside it under WHAT CHANGES FROM EASY TO MEGA, and a real party's bars from 2 commanders up

questions.text: The paratrooper's landing reach is 76.2 px from where he lands (the row's 60 + 30 % of the man's width), and the landing point sways up to 9 px under the chute: a man 80 px from the shadow was reached on 2 of 8 runs (measured both). The dashboard says 76.2 px.
The stone wall and the reflect are switched off (both switches at 0 in the client): the Emperor on foot never braces or catches a rocket. Intended since 0904 (Sep 3); the page says so.
MEGA brings no new hit to the fields (no +20 %, no double weather: the castle's law). MEGA is only x1.8 HP and x1.5 heads.

THE BOSS LAB's party slider is a solo fight with a party's bar: since the player-damage-threshold pass (v29.30) its multiplier is figured through the rung's price and a real party's through none, each kept at four decimals, so from MEDIUM up the slider reads 2 to 55 HP UNDER what a real party meets (2 commanders on MEDIUM at level 57: the lab says 3,145, a real party meets 3,147, measured as born); before the player-damage-threshold pass (v29.30) it read higher (443 against 390). A party pays the tier alone by the twin-sim law (the price multiplier returns 1 while a party launches).
questions.rec: a read for Raziya: the gap is the multiplier's rounding now, not the price, and the slider is close enough to quote; if it should match a real party to the HP, a small card (the lab's own sheet could drop the price when the party is 2 or more)

questions.text: Wyatt's note asked that flamers take 4 to 6 lieutenant cuts before dying; the card (CARD-EBA, v31.20) priced the cut at 3.6 HP on a fresh flame of 16 HP, but at the lab's levels a flame stands 121 · 121 · 130 · 140 HP (the flame's tripled rungs through level 50), so a fresh flame falls to cut 34 · 34 · 37 · 39 (E · M · H · G).
questions.rec: a word for Wyatt: keep the flat 3.6 HP, or price the cut as a share of the flame's own HP so 4 to 6 cuts hold at every level

questions.text: The proof stands Sarge's shotgun and Claymore under no priced blow: their saves (the riot shield eats its first five blows whole, the Claymore's counted block its own) come before the bite and are not added to WHO SURVIVES here, which counts the bites alone.

questions.text: WHO SURVIVES gives the stock saber Sarge 26 saddle swings to a KO at the lab's level 50 (26 · 26 · 26 · 26 on E · M · H · G): his bar, one bar hit x the damper's 50 % x his share a swing, by the page's own words (a blade in hand keeps his feet, measured once). Nobody counted him down under the swing on the machines, so that cell is the read's arithmetic, not a measurement (no dot in its corner).
